benchmark.domain: ordinary non-profiled relinks, compiled-in RTS -s, fresh foundation14
benchmark.limitations: Guard wall and whole-process RTS allocated bytes are separate domains. No exclusive attribution, native-generation result, profiled allocation equality, statistical significance, or general workload speedup is inferred.

interpretation.remaining: Use separately validated fine solver diagnostic to split the observed 58.36% SOLVE allocation bucket. Current candidate not merged; latest-main integration and required CI not run.
interpretation.runtime: Median guard wall is 1.69% lower, but candidate is slower in 2 of 6 adjacent pairs. This run does not establish a reliable speedup.
interpretation.scope: This tiny paired-input reuse saves 0.2962% of ordinary whole-process allocation, not the entire 17.21% ENCODE profiling bucket. No GHC parity, whole compiler90, native-generation or full regression claim.

reported_gc_percent.interpretation: raw reported field only; may be inconsistent; not measured GC share
